tradeInReducesBase.note: Dealer may subtract a trade-in allowance when tangible personal property is traded in one transaction. In a private sale the buyer must trade in an aircraft, boat, vehicle or mobile home in the same transaction to get the deduction.

value.rangeNote: Discretionary surtax is set by county and applies to only the first $5,000 of the price.

local.note: DOR: discretionary sales surtax applies to the first $5,000 of the purchase price, based on the county of the purchaser's address. County rates are in form DR-15DSS.

outOfStateCredit.note: Credit against Florida tax when documentation shows a like tax was lawfully paid to another state, territory or DC.

amount.note: FLHSMV electronic title fees: transfer/duplicate $75.25, original new vehicle $77.25, original used $85.25. Add $2.50 for a paper title and $2 if a lien is recorded.
